name: Card Construct I
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, F (1 card from a deck of cards per animated card)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect one animated card
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You toss out a card and it grows in size turning into a CR 1/2 animated card.
